answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and therefore paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in hollow, verified in river, and plume names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 11 submissions per epoch. A 446 account operation therefore ties up 25 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
